description: The default date type exports only YYYY-MM-DD. Explicit time, local date-time, instant and zoned types keep their own value semantics; display formatting never changes the binding type. Editable dates and times with canonical string values, localized numeric typing, Temporal validation, inclusive bounds and declarative date availability. Native inputs remain usable before upgrade; precision and space-separated local values use text fallbacks to retain their serialization. Enhanced input preserves incomplete drafts and submits canonical values. A set-value CustomEvent with canonical detail.value commits an explicit choice and replaces the draft, including when its accepted value is unchanged.
summary: Type dates and times without changing their stored meaning.
